scaling_model.spatial_policy: mechanical fixed-layout scaling from p2/h3, p3/h3 and p4/h5 M160 stress-test scenarios; no common target-accuracy claim
scaling_model.mode_policy: M scales with transverse reciprocal-order area, s^2
scaling_model.dense_multi_rhs_policy: local FE rows times modal RHS, s^5
scaling_model.uncertainty: engineering component envelope; lifecycle overlap, simultaneous extrapolated peak, material dispersion, target-accuracy DoF, cutoff changes and future solver redesign are unknown

decision.current_layout_0p7nm: single-component bottlenecks or cumulative-envelope budget crossings occur in the stress-test scenarios
required_redesign: matrix-free or low-storage iterative local solver

limitations: Predictions are not PDE runs and do not authorize a launch.
No failed adaptive raw DoF ratio is credited as accuracy-preserving compression.
Sparse factor and QEP fill exponents are engineering proxies, not exact asymptotics.
Predicted mode counts require future physical convergence validation.
The p2/p3/p4 scenarios are current-layout mechanical stress tests, not an equal-accuracy p-refinement comparison.
Extrapolated simultaneous peak is unknown because component lifecycle overlap was not modelled.
